title: Choose the visual world for NextOwn
question: The roll assigned The Exercise Book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Brand colours, Inter and the logo stay fixed in every option.

options.label: The Exercise Book
options.lineage: Nigerian school exercise books: margin rule, ruled rhythm, the teacher's tick
options.thesis: Every trade is written out like a neat sum: terms in the working, the answer underlined, a tick only when both sides check out.
materials: Teal margin rule (the red margin, translated to brand)
options.viewport: Explore: logo and area, search, Sell / Swap / Quick Sell chips, then listing cards whose facts sit on one baseline rhythm beside a thin Teal margin rule.
options.risk: Reads childish if the ruling becomes a lined-paper texture; the rhythm must stay structural.

raised.raise: Every counteroffer shows its exact delta (+₦50,000, payer changed) instead of asking people to compare.
Deadlines are bars whose length is the real time left; never an animated countdown.
Explore repacks in whole cards and quietly marks listings you've already opened.
The handover is one line from 'Check terms' to 'Both confirmed', always showing where you are on it.
A strict 4 / 8 / 12 grid with tabular numerals, so ₦ amounts align down every list.

options.label: The Duplicate Receipt Book
options.thesis: Every agreement is a matched duplicate: both people hold the same copy of the same terms.
materials: top copy and Mint carbon copy
options.viewport: Explore as a clean photo grid; offers and agreements open as a white top copy over a Mint carbon copy, numbered NX-000123.
options.risk: Receipt and ticket UIs are a familiar fintech trope; also where many marketplace runs land.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a tinted ground, and Teal appears only where something can be pressed.
options.viewport: A single column of roomy cards on Mint, a thumb-reachable bottom bar, Teal reserved for actions.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and reads instantly as an app; loses on identification, since nothing about it says Nigerian secondhand trade.
options.risk: Generic: any consumer app could wear it.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Overlapping translucent sheets with hatch density as state.
options.viewport: Stacked translucent sheets over a zone wedge.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hatching would compete with item photos and defects.
options.kept: Quantified difference: every counteroffer shows its exact delta.
options.risk: Unreadable to people who never used a darkroom.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: A vertical staff where block length is exact duration.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience link and it slows reading.
options.kept: Length is time: deadlines drawn as honest bars.
options.risk: Abstract to the point of confusion.

options.label: Convention Catalogue
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-sized thumbnails in a numbered hall grid.
options.viewport: A dense numbered grid of tiny thumbnails.
options.case: Fuses poorly: stamp-sized photos hide the defects buyers must see.
options.kept: Whole-card repacking and a quiet 'seen' mark.
options.risk: Too dense for a phone on slow data.

options.label: Midnight Transit Map
options.thesis: Coloured lines and interchanges as a promise of movement.
options.viewport: A dark map with bright routes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a dark enamel ground fights the light Brand Kit.
options.kept: One corridor in focus: handover progress as a single line.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: Monumental grid type over a visible grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: display letterforms would replace the approved Inter type.
options.kept: The grid as armature: tabular numerals that align down every list.

canonCard.label: The marketplace standard
canonCard.thesis: What secondhand marketplaces ship: a photo grid, price-first cards, a bottom bar, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Search bar, category chips, a two-column photo grid with prices, a bottom navigation bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Jiji or Facebook Marketplace by design.
